description: This file implements a ring buffer management system for display buffers, including creation, memory mapping, frame writing, and reading functionalities within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: DisplayRingBuffer
classes.description: Manages a ring buffer for display frames, including creation, memory access, and frame management.

classes.name: DisplayRingBufferHeader
classes.description: Stores metadata about the display ring buffer such as dimensions and last valid frame index.

classes.name: DisplayRingBufferManager
classes.description: Handles multiple display ring buffers, including creation, reading, and writing frames, and generating shared memory names.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Returns the memory address of the ring buffer.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new shared memory ring buffer with specified name and size.

methods.name: ShmemGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an existing shared memory ring buffer by name and size.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ring buffer with memory address, name, ownership flag, and memory mapping.

methods.name: WriteNextFrame
methods.description: Writes frame data to the next position in the ring buffer and updates the last valid frame index.

methods.name: CurrentFrame
methods.description: Returns the current frame's memory address based on the last valid frame index.

methods.name: ComputeFrameAddressForIndex
methods.description: Calculates the memory address for a given frame index within the buffer.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the display width, height, bits per pixel, and last valid frame index in the header.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferManager
methods.description: Manages multiple ring buffers, providing creation, reading, and writing functionalities.

methods.name: CreateLocalDisplayBuffer
methods.description: Creates a local display buffer with specified dimensions and stores it in the cache.

methods.name: WriteFrame
methods.description: Writes a frame to a specified buffer in the cache.

methods.name: ReadFrame
methods.description: Reads the current frame from a specified buffer, mapping it if necessary.

methods.name: MakeLayerName
methods.description: Generates a shared memory name based on display and VM indices.
